scope: Future external opt-in review only; this checklist is not a source manifest, source admission, creator consent, SEO, demand, or revenue proof.

items.requiredEvidence: Verified identity and documented authority to grant permissions for the named content.
items.passRule: An authorized person and the covered content are unambiguously identified in retained documentation.

items.requiredEvidence: Rights evidence mapped separately for video, audio, transcript, thumbnails, and derivative excerpts.
items.passRule: Every planned content type has an explicit permitted-use statement from an authorized party.

items.requiredEvidence: A dated consent record specifying approved uses, surfaces, duration, territory, and exclusions.
items.passRule: The proposed use is expressly within the documented scope and no exclusion applies.

items.requiredEvidence: Authorized timestamp references and independently reproducible local validation observations.
items.passRule: Each proposed moment has a bounded timestamp range and a retained validation result within the stated tolerance.

items.requiredEvidence: Documented authorized access route and an explicit indexability decision for each proposed surface.
items.passRule: Access is authorized and the indexability decision is explicitly recorded before any publication decision.

items.requiredEvidence: A named contact path and procedure for corrections, removals, and consent revocation.
items.passRule: A requested correction, removal, or revocation can be attributed, logged, and completed within the agreed process.

items.requiredEvidence: A data inventory stating personal data, retention period, access roles, and deletion method.
items.passRule: No personal data is retained without a documented purpose, access boundary, retention limit, and deletion procedure.

items.requiredEvidence: Separately collected, attributable research evidence with method, sample limits, and stated uncertainty.
items.passRule: Evidence describes observed interest or differentiation limits without converting it into a demand, SEO, or revenue claim.
